Dear Brightloop Support,

I am writing to express my frustration regarding my recent purchase of the Chime Pro doorbell, order number BL-739204. I placed this order on March 3rd and received the unit on March 8th. Upon installation, I discovered that the doorbell is missing the mounting bracket entirely, which makes it completely unusable in its current state. I have contacted support twice already and was told to wait 5 to 7 business days for a replacement part, yet it has now been over two weeks with no resolution. The device sits on my kitchen counter gathering dust while I have to answer every single door call in person, which defeats the entire purpose of purchasing a video doorbell in the first place. I would like to either receive a complete replacement unit with all components included, or have my order fully refunded so I can purchase from a retailer that actually ships complete products. I would appreciate a response within the next 48 hours as I am at my limit with this situation.

Sincerely,
Marcus

Dear Brightloop Team,

I hope you are doing well. I recently purchased the Aura thermostat and I must say I am absolutely delighted with it. The installation was surprisingly straightforward and the app integration feels seamless. I was wondering if you could tell me a bit more about the scheduling features. Specifically, I have noticed that I can set different temperatures for different days of the week, but I am curious whether it is possible to create a more granular schedule, say with different settings for morning, afternoon, and evening on the same day. I have also been thinking about whether the Aura thermostat can be linked to a smart home hub, or if it operates entirely on its own ecosystem. I ask because I am a bit of a tinkerer and I love the idea of having all my smart devices talking to one another. Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Margaret Chen
